name: dimokol
description: Hooks, skills and an MCP server for running several coding agents at once. Install only the parts you want.

plugins.name: starter
plugins.description: Installs git-guardrails, machine-pressure, worktree-hygiene and agent-chat in one go.

plugins.name: git-guardrails
plugins.description: Agents can't merge PRs, push to protected branches, delete remote branches or run reset --hard unless you said so.

plugins.name: pr-task-link-guard
plugins.description: gh pr create is refused when the PR body has no link to a task.

plugins.name: machine-pressure
plugins.description: One e2e or Docker run at a time, no heavy commands while the machine is in the red, plus a statusline script you add by hand.

plugins.name: context-nudge
plugins.description: A one-line nudge when a session passes 250k, 400k and 600k tokens of context, or after an hour idle at 150k or more.

plugins.name: worktree-hygiene
plugins.description: An audit to run at session start: merged worktrees, idle dependency folders, orphaned dev servers and free disk.

plugins.name: storage-reclaim
plugins.description: Disk cleanup that measures first and won't touch files a process or session is using. macOS.

plugins.name: agent-chat
plugins.description: Chat rooms for agents in different terminals, as a zero-dependency MCP server.

plugins.name: verify-before-building
plugins.description: Fetches and checks the trunk before you branch, so nobody rebuilds what already merged.

plugins.name: pr-review-loop
plugins.description: Asks the reviewer once, applies or answers every finding, reruns your checks, stops when the PR is ready.

plugins.name: integration-branch-qa
plugins.description: Test several approved PRs at once on one local branch that never gets pushed.

plugins.name: e2e-harness-patterns
plugins.description: A local e2e stack per worktree, so several agents can run end-to-end tests side by side.

plugins.name: setup-audit
plugins.description: A weekly read of the Claude Code changelog plus your own drift checks, written to a log.
